questions.question: Describe your hands-on experience testing and commissioning electrical equipment such as transformers, generators, battery chargers, VFDs, battery banks, and distribution panels.
Walk me through a plant electrical fault you troubleshot: how did you isolate the issue, what tests did you perform, and what corrective action did you recommend?
This role requires troubleshooting down to the lowest Line Replaceable Unit (LRU). What systematic approach would you use to isolate a fault using schematics, functional diagrams, and wire lists?
What experience do you have reading and interpreting electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, protection drawings, and control circuits?

Which electrical test instruments have you used in the field, such as digital multimeters, insulation testers, clamp meters, relay test equipment, data recorders, or voltage/current measurement instruments?
Describe your experience with AC and DC power systems, including the voltage ranges you have worked with and the safety precautions you apply before testing energized or de-energized equipment.
In your work with generator and transformer systems, how have you diagnosed problems involving ATS operation, protection relays, switchgear, or distribution equipment?
Give an example of a test, inspection, breakdown, or equipment anomaly that you documented. What information did you capture in the report, and how was it used by management or maintenance teams?
What experience do you have installing, terminating, commissioning, or repairing electrical panels, cables, and associated components?

This position works in a heavy industrial rail environment and may require shift work, overtime, outdoor work, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Are you able to work under these conditions, and what safety practices do you follow during electrical testing and maintenance?
